title: Presenting with impact virtually made super easy
quote: I attended the training on "Presenting with Impact Virtually" which was engaging and super helpful. The training provided me with very practical advise on how to present in a virtual setting with the most possible impact on the audience. Particularly good was that the presenter used short and concise explanations of the various topics followed by an easy and practical exercise where all participants got to practice what they have just heard. That way is was much easier to remember what was taught and made the whole session fun.
author: Sabine Kobienia
subject: Virtual Presentation Skills
